competitors.name: Store brands / private label
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported Spins findings that Gen Z and millennials accounted for 81% of year-over-year gains in private-label spending for the 52 weeks ending June 14. Spins called out pizza as a category with high young-shopper penetration and low private-label share, making it a target for store-brand innovation.

competitors.name: Sprouts Farmers Market
competitors.action: Sprouts announced that president and COO Nick Konat will become CEO and join the board on Jan. 4, 2027, while Jack Sinclair becomes executive chairman. Progressive Grocer reported Sprouts expects 42 net new stores this year, with at least 15 openings in Q3, and organic items now represent more than 30% of total sales.

competitors.name: Bay Food Brokerage
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Bay Food Brokerage launched a formal retail division with 28 full-time retail representatives serving stores in eight Southeastern states. The division supports manufacturers with secondary display execution, inventory management, price and promotion verification, planogram integrity and real-time in-store visibility through its BEACON portal.

trends.topic: Younger shoppers accelerating private-label competition in pizza
trends.magnitude: Gen Z and millennials drove 81% of private-label spending gains; Spins identified pizza as a target category.
trends.context: Retailers have a data-backed reason to add or upgrade store-brand pizza, increasing pressure on branded frozen pizza to defend differentiation beyond price.

trends.topic: Natural and organic specialty retail expansion
trends.magnitude: Sprouts expects 42 net new stores in 2026, including at least 15 openings in Q3.
trends.context: Expansion at a natural/organic retailer increases potential premium grocery doors, but new leadership will likely keep pressure on velocity, innovation and fit with health-oriented shoppers.

trends.topic: CPG in-store execution services becoming more data-enabled
trends.magnitude: Bay Food Brokerage reports 28 full-time retail reps and roughly 30% more store visits by its retail team.
trends.context: For emerging frozen and refrigerated brands, sell-in is increasingly paired with proof of shelf execution, promotion compliance and store-level issue detection.
